entities.summary: Yuan, a notable figure in the history of Mongolia, associated with Successor Khanates and Yuan Connection (1260–1294). Preceded by Kublai Khan and Mongol China. Their legacy influenced Kublai Khan moves the capital to Dadu (Beijing) and proclaims the Yuan dynasty and Marco Polo travels through the Mongol Empire to Kublai Khan's court.
